lines.text: On the plains of Moab, the LORD tells Moses to have the Israelites give the Levites cities and pasturelands.
The Levites receive forty-eight cities in all, six of them cities of refuge, given in proportion to each tribe's inheritance.
Three cities of refuge are across the Jordan and three are in Moab, for someone who kills unintentionally.

wrong_details.true: three in the land of Canaan

lines.text: The assembly protects the manslayer, who must live in his city of refuge until the death of the king.
No one is executed on one witness's testimony, and the LORD says no ransom may be accepted for a murderer.
